Admin Guide — Fescue League

League Admin
Tournament Setup Course & Holes Players Groups Day-of Check-In Live Scoring Leaderboard

This guide covers everything you need to run the Fescue League on Lotus Links — from setting up a tournament to watching the live leaderboard on the day of play. You're logged in as a League Admin, which gives you access to all setup, player management, grouping, and scoring tools. Reach out to Anthan for anything platform-level (adding admins, billing, etc.).

1
Creating a Tournament
1

Open Fescue League Dashboard

Log in at links.getlotusai.com — you'll land directly on the Fescue league dashboard showing all tournaments.

2

Create New Tournament

Click + New Tournament. Enter the tournament name, date, and select the scoring format (Stroke Play, Stableford, Scramble, etc.). You can change the format later before scores are submitted.

3

Configure Tournament Settings

Set the tee time start type (standard or shotgun start), enable or disable handicap adjustments, and choose which 9 holes or full 18 you're playing.

✦ Enable Shotgun Start if all groups tee off simultaneously — this changes the tee time email template automatically.
4

Save & Continue

Hit Save Tournament. The tournament is now in Draft status — players won't see results until you publish.

2
Course & Hole Setup
Course Details

Navigate to the Course tab inside your tournament. Enter the course name, yardage, slope rating, and course rating. These are used for USGA handicap calculations.

Hole-by-Hole Configuration

For each hole enter: par, stroke index (handicap allocation), and yardage. If the course isn't in the system yet, you'll set all 18 holes manually.

  • Par is required for every hole
  • Stroke index determines handicap strokes per hole (1 = hardest)
  • Yardage is optional but recommended
Front 9 / Back 9 / Custom

If you're only playing 9 holes, select Front 9 or Back 9 from the hole selection toggle. You can also pick a custom set of holes.

3
Adding Players
Add Players Manually

Go to the Players tab and click + Add Player. Enter name, email, and handicap index. Players added here are registered for this tournament only.

Bulk Import via Template

For larger fields, download the CSV template from the Players tab, fill in player details, and re-upload. The system will validate and import in one step.

Handicap Index

Enter each player's USGA Handicap Index. Lotus Links automatically converts it to a Course Handicap based on the slope/rating you set. Net scores are calculated from there.

✦ Don't have a player's handicap? Enter 0 — they'll play to scratch and only gross scores will apply to them.

FieldRequired?Notes
NameYesFirst & last shown on leaderboard
EmailYesUsed for tee time emails & scoring links
Handicap IndexRecommendedUSGA index (not course handicap)
Team / DivisionOptionalFor team formats or tiered leaderboards
4
Creating Groups & Tee Times
1

Go to Groups Tab

Inside your tournament, open the Groups tab. This is where you build pairings and assign tee times.

2

Create a Group

Click + New Group, give it a name (e.g. "Group 1" or a fun team name), then assign players from your registered list. Typical groups are 2–4 players.

3

Assign a Tee Time

Set the tee time for each group. For shotgun starts, assign the starting hole instead. You can search by player name to find which group they're in.

4

Assign a Scorer

Each group needs a designated scorer — typically one of the players in the group. Add their email to the group and they'll receive a unique scoring link that opens directly to the group's scorecard. No login required.

✦ Scoring links can be re-sent any time from the admin panel if someone loses the email.
5

Send Scoring Links

Once all groups are set, use Send All Links (or send per-group) to email each scorer their unique link. You'll see a sent/pending status per group from the admin panel.

5
Day-of Check-In
Player Check-In

On the day of the tournament, open the Check-In view from your admin dashboard. As players arrive, mark them as checked in. This updates the groupings view in real time.

Handling No-Shows

If a player doesn't show, remove them from their group before play starts. The system will recalculate net scores for the updated group. You can re-add them later if they arrive late.

Last-Minute Group Changes

Players can be moved between groups at any point before scores are submitted. After moving a player, re-send the affected groups' scoring links.

✦ Keep the admin panel open on your phone for quick adjustments at the first tee.
6
Live Scoring
How Group Scoring Works

Each group's designated scorer receives an email with a unique link. Tapping it opens a mobile scorecard — no login or account required. They enter scores hole by hole and submit when the round is complete.

Monitoring Submissions

From the Admin Scoring View, you can see which groups have submitted and which are still in progress. Scores appear on the leaderboard as soon as a group submits.

Editing a Score

If a group submits an incorrect score, you can override it from the admin panel under Groups → [Group Name] → Edit Scores. Changes update the leaderboard instantly.

✦ Only edit scores before publishing final results — once published, scores are locked for the record.
7
Leaderboard & Publishing Results
1

Live Leaderboard

The leaderboard updates in real time as groups submit scores. Share the public leaderboard link with players — they can follow along on their phones without needing an account.

2

Net vs. Gross Toggle

The leaderboard shows both net (handicap-adjusted) and gross scores. Use the toggle at the top of the leaderboard to switch views. Handicap calculations follow the USGA formula.

3

Publish Final Results

Once all groups have submitted and you've verified the scores, click Publish Results from the tournament admin page. This locks the tournament as Completed and activates the championship celebration view.

✦ Double-check all groups show "Submitted" before publishing — you can't unpublish without admin help.
